text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Bonjour☆ Sorry to keep you waiting. It is 
I, the world's genius designer, Beauty 
Anshinzawa♪

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
So, where might the Umamusume I'm 
scheduled to meet today be?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
The new racing outfit draft I received 
from her—! Bursting passion! Overflowing 
energy! A sparkling heartbeat and surging 
juvenile spirit!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ahn! The chapel bells are ringing! My 
rough diamond! I want to see you right 
away~~!
